title: Keep the extinguisher clear
lines: A perfectly good extinguisher is useless if it's blocked.
Pallets, pipes or equipment can block it without anyone noticing.
In a fire, every second counts.
So keep a clear path to it at all times.
And never put anything in front of it, not even for a moment.
An extinguisher you can reach is one that saves.
Tal's daily tip. Ofek At Tal Cranes.
